header.contentDescription: Pendulum period as a 3D surface over length and amplitude, nearly flat in amplitude until large swings

drawTextAnchored.text: Length does almost all of it
the green lines run up the length axis and climb: four times longer is twice as slow
the pale lines run across amplitude and stay level - under 20 degrees the period moves less than one per cent
the far edge is an 80 degree swing: nearly 10 per cent slow, which is why clock pendulums swing narrowly
a surface that is flat one way and not the other
